clue.text: Odious credit overlaps exploited

explanation.definitionFit: Cursed can mean hateful or abominable, as in 'that cursed thing', a close synonym of odious.

clue.text: Capitol, maybe, after capturing Illinois with dash (when will Trump's come to an end?)
